<thought>The most intense peak is at m/z 182.0732, which in positive‑mode ESI corresponds to [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈181.0659 Da. The isotopic pattern (M+1 ≈ 14 % of M) suggests about 13 carbons (each C contributes ~1.1 % to M+1). A formula that fits the exact mass and the carbon count is C₁₃H₉O (156.0000 + 9.0704 + 15.9949 = 181.0653 Da), matching the observed mass within <1 mDa. Hence the molecular formula is C13H9O.</thought>
<final_answer>C13H9O</final_answer>
